title: Update dependency htmx.org to v2.0.11 (forgejo)
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Change | [Age](https://docs.renovatebot.com/merge-confidence/) | [Confidence](https://docs.renovatebot.com/merge-confidence/) |
|---|---|---|---|
| [htmx.org](https://htmx.org/) ([source](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx)) | [`2.0.10` → `2.0.11`](https://renovatebot.com/diffs/npm/htmx.org/2.0.10/2.0.11) | ![age](https://developer.mend.io/api/mc/badges/age/npm/htmx.org/2.0.11?slim=true) | ![confidence](https://developer.mend.io/api/mc/badges/confidence/npm/htmx.org/2.0.10/2.0.11?slim=true) |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>bigskysoftware/htmx (htmx.org)</summary>

### [`v2.0.11`](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#2011---2026-09-22)

[Compare Source](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/compare/v2.0.10...v2.0.11)

- [Added](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/pull/4050) `<hx-partial>` tag support, backported from 4.0: a response can carry `<hx-partial hx-target="...">` elements that swap into their own targets (thanks [@​MichaelWest22](https://github.com/MichaelWest22))
- [Fixed](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/pull/4093) `hx-push-url="false"` on an ancestor of a boosted element being ignored [Issue 3966](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/issues/3966) (thanks [@​MichaelWest22](https://github.com/MichaelWest22))
- [Fixed](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/pull/3772) `hasHeader()` substring match on response header names, which could throw a `TypeError` [Issue 527](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/issues/527) (thanks [@​manwithacat](https://github.com/manwithacat))
- [Fixed](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/pull/3998) OOB swap targets not found when the context element is detached from the document [Issue 3959](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/issues/3959) (thanks [@​yfwmaniish](https://github.com/yfwmaniish))
- [Updated](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/pull/3381) internal object iteration to use `Object.keys()` instead of `for...in` (thanks [@​yawaramin](https://github.com/yawaramin))
- [Fixed](https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/pull/3435) `@default` JSDoc value for `selfRequestsOnly` (thanks [@​blister](https://github.com/blister))

</details>

milestone.title: Forgejo v18.0.0
milestone.description:
## Release notes - Breaking security features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14148): Move internal communication to UNIX socket. The `INTERNAL_TOKEN` can now be dropped from the configuration, the UNIX socket path and permissions can be configured using the `INTERNAL_LISTENER_PATH` and `INTERNAL_LISTENER_PERMISSIONS` options. This change removes the `./forgejo generate secret INTERNAL_TOKEN` command and updates the contrib Forgejo systemd unit file.
See the [documentation](https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/admin/config-cheat-sheet/#server-server) for more information. - User Interface features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14536): make dropdowns dialog-based with various improvements - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14158): accessible aria-labels & working commit description toggles w/o JS - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14522): disable text wrapping in code blocks - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13517): auth: start oauth2 login if its the only available login - User Interface bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14435): Fix icons in milestone and project metadata not being consistent with how icons are used elsewhere on Forgejo - Features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14386): feat(lfs): add lfs file support to /render endpoint - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13023): add code suggestion - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14117): team membership provenance tracking - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14505): feat(feed): parse and set limit parameter for release feed request - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14164): feat(cmd): allow password to be read from stdin - User Interface changes without a feature or bug label - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14598): sort user repositories in package linking, make input searchable - Other changes without a feature or bug label - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14621): deleting a user w/ repo-specific access tokens or authorized integrations causes foreign-key violation - Included for completeness but not user-facing (chores, etc.) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13971): feat(api): endpoints to manipulate team invites - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14583): share the head branch check + improve suggestion error - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14508): refactor: migrate relative-time component to Typescript - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14606): Update dependency htmx.org to v2.0.11 (forgejo) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14629): accept Arch Linux packages with non-zero epoch - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14582): less flaky markdown-editor e2e test - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14572): refactor(tests): change all remaining `tests.CreateDeclarativeRepo` to `forgery.CreateRepository` - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14604): avoid unconditional UPDATE query in diff view style preference - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14605): re-use `git cat-file` when possible - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14577): Update renovate Docker tag to v44.117.2 (forgejo) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14590): nit(forgery): add http server hint to comment - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14510): nit(lfs): add comment for lfsAuthenticateVerb - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14580): chore: update `typescript` to v6 - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14578): Update dependency @lezer/highlight to v1.2.4 (forgejo) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14535): Fix LFS raw file test, add additional cases - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14553): prevent off by one by excluding `size == 1024` in `BlobsLessThan1024...` - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14540): improve error message in case of token not found - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14457): Update golang packages to v1.27 (forgejo) - autoclosed - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14406): chore: setting/security better testing, refactoring, add onlySymmetric() and onlyHS256() key config constraints - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14562): test: fix intermittent test failure in `TestAPIAuthWithAuthorizedIntegration` - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14561): Update CodeMirror (forgejo) - autoclosed - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14183): fix(ui): make font size of repo watchers count consistent with stars and forks - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14155): Update module github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint to v2.14.0 (forgejo) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14543): chore(release): v17 is cut - run renovate on v17 branch - Already announced in the release notes of an older stable release - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14647): reduce memory usage during Actions log & artifacts uploads - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14318): set Content-Length header when serving package files - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14599): Slack PR notifications using wrong link format - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14614): fix(api): workflow dispatch returns 4xx errors on unknown ref and workflow - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14252): filter issues by enabled repo units when populating dashboard lists
